about_the_game:
"Matrix Blacksmith" is a hybrid simulation game where you manage a shop, striving to become the strongest blacksmith by cycling between the Blacksmithing Phase and the Battle Phase.

🔪 Blacksmithing Phase: Forge the Right Weapon by Identifying the Customer's "Preferred Weapon"!

Adventurers seeking various weapons like Swords, Axes, Bows, and Staffs will continuously visit your shop (over 100 types of customers are expected to appear!).

  • Weapon Selection and Forging: You don't know which weapon the visiting customer prefers! Select one of the four weapon types and forge it using a timing-based mini-game.

  • Information Gathering Game: To identify the preferred weapon quickly, you must hit the "winning" word in a simple timing game.

  • Memory and Efficiency: By memorizing the customer's appearance and characteristics, you can remember their preferred weapon, skip the information gathering, and proceed quickly to weapon creation! Provide the optimal weapon to as many customers as possible within the time limit.

🛡️ Battle Phase: Where the True Worth of Your Forged Weapons is Tested!

When the time limit is reached, the game transitions to the Battle Phase.

  • The adventurers you provided weapons to in the Blacksmithing Phase form a party and fight against enemies.

  • After the enemies are wiped out, the adventurer who dealt the most damage and contributed the most is selected as the "MVP."

  • You can give the MVP a nickname, making them easier to remember as a regular customer.

⚒️ SHOP Function and Growth Loop

  • The "SHOP," available after the battle, allows you to purchase enhancements to improve the efficiency of both the Blacksmithing and Battle Phases.

  • After repeating the loop of "Blacksmithing Phase" → "Battle Phase" → "SHOP" three times, a Boss will appear in the Battle Phase!

  • Defeating the Boss clears one stage. Aim to clear all four stages!

Other Features

  • Gacha System: Enjoy the fun of increasing the variety of adventurers and filling up the encyclopedia.

  • Encyclopedia (Illustrations Book) Feature: Collect information on the customers and weapons that appear in the game.

short_description: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!
